name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction via GPU Coarse-to-Fine Voxelization
definition: An algorithm to construct a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) from a mesh by iteratively voxelizing the scene at increasing resolutions (coarse nodes), compacting occupied nodes, and building the octree hierarchy level by level on the GPU using thrust scans and custom CUDA kernels.
summary: This GPU algorithm builds sparse voxel octrees by iteratively voxelizing at increasing resolutions, reducing memory overhead for sparse scenes compared to dense approaches.
